Legal / Privacy

Your privacy
is not optional.

This Policy explains how Develop Mobile App handles information when you use our Android applications and related services.

Effective date: October 15, 2026 · Last updated: October 15, 2026

1. Scope of this Policy

This Privacy Policy applies to mobile applications developed and offered on Google Play by Develop Mobile App, as well as websites or related services that link to this Policy. It explains the types of information that may be processed, why it is used, how it is protected, and the choices available to you.

2. Information We May Process

Device and connection information

Depending on the application and features you use, technical data may include device type, operating-system and app versions, app or device identifiers, language, time zone, network status, IP address, diagnostics, and crash reports.

Application usage data

We may process app-launch count, session duration, features used, settings, performance, and in-app interactions. For purchases or subscriptions, Google Play may provide transaction status; we do not receive your complete payment-card details.

Content and information you provide

When you choose to use a feature, the app may process text, images, or audio necessary to fulfill your request. If you contact support, we may receive your email address, message, screenshots, and technical information you voluntarily provide.

The actual data practices of each app are also described in its Google Play Data safety section. We do not sell your personal information.

3. How We Use Information

  • Provide, operate, maintain, and improve our applications.
  • Personalize your experience and remember your settings.
  • Process features or transactions you request.
  • Analyze performance, troubleshoot problems, and develop new features.
  • Respond to questions, support requests, and product feedback.
  • Prevent fraud and abuse and protect the security of our services.
  • Comply with legal obligations and enforce applicable terms.

4. Android Permissions

An app may request an Android permission when it is required for a feature you choose to use, such as camera, microphone, photos and videos, files, notifications, or network access. Each app requests only permissions relevant to its functionality. You can review, grant, or revoke permissions at any time in your device settings. Refusing a permission may prevent the related feature from working.

5. AI Processing

Some apps may use artificial intelligence to process content at your request—for example, to generate, classify, transcribe, or summarize it. When a third-party service is required, only the information needed to provide that feature is sent. AI output may be inaccurate; review it before relying on it for important decisions.

6. Sharing and Disclosure

Information may be shared with service providers needed to operate an app, deliver features, process payments, analyze performance, send notifications, display advertising when an app is ad-supported, or resolve errors. Information may also be disclosed at your request, when required by law, or to protect the rights, safety, and integrity of our services. Third parties handle information under their own privacy policies.

7. Third-Party Services and SDKs

Depending on the app, we may integrate Google services such as Google Play Services, Google Play Billing, Firebase, or Google AdMob. Not every service is used by every app. Review the app’s Data safety section and consent screens for the services actually in use.

  • Google Privacy Policy
  • Privacy and Security in Firebase
  • How Google Uses Data for Advertising

8. Legal Bases for Processing

Where applicable law requires a legal basis, we process information as necessary to perform our agreement with you and provide the service; to comply with legal obligations; for legitimate interests such as security, support, and product improvement; or with your consent. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting processing already performed lawfully.

9. Data Retention and Security

We retain information only as long as needed for the purposes described, operational requirements, or legal obligations, and then delete or anonymize it where appropriate. We use reasonable technical and organizational safeguards, but no method of transmission or storage is completely secure.

10. Your Rights and Choices

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, or object to processing; obtain a portable copy; withdraw consent; or complain to a competent data-protection authority. You can revoke Android permissions, reset your advertising ID, adjust advertising choices, or uninstall the app. We may need to verify your identity before completing a request.

11. Information for California Residents

If California law applies, you may have rights to know the categories of personal information collected, request access or deletion, correct inaccurate information, limit certain uses of sensitive information, and receive equal service when exercising your rights. We do not sell personal information for money. Requests may be submitted using the email below.

12. Children’s Privacy

Our apps are not intentionally directed to children under 13, or the equivalent minimum age in the relevant jurisdiction, unless an app listing clearly states otherwise and appropriate safeguards are in place. If we learn that children’s data has been processed improperly, we will take appropriate steps to delete it.

13. International Data Transfers

Service providers may process data in a country other than the one where you live. Where required, we rely on lawful transfer mechanisms and appropriate safeguards under applicable law.

14. Changes to this Policy

We may update this Policy as our apps, technology, or legal requirements change. The revised version will be posted on this page with a new “Last updated” date. If a change materially affects you, we will provide additional notice where appropriate.

15. Contact Us

If you have questions, a data request, or concerns about this Policy, please contact:
